text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Could you lend me a hand for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Can you tell? That I am trembling. 
This trembling is the excitement in my 
heart."
choice_data_list: This is so exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to pass along this 
excitement to everyone watching the race 
too.
